title: Exact Tangent of pi over Four
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the exact value of $\tan\left(\dfrac{\pi}{4}\right)$ using the quotient identity and known special-angle values.

steps.title: Invoke the Quotient Identity
steps.explanation: Tangent is the ratio of sine to cosine, so both special-angle values are needed.

steps.title: Insert the 45-45-90 Values
steps.explanation: At $\pi/4=45^{\circ}$ the legs of the isosceles right triangle are equal, giving $\sin(\pi/4)=\cos(\pi/4)=\sqrt{2}/2$.
steps.why: Equal legs are the geometric reason sine and cosine agree at $45^{\circ}$.

steps.title: Reduce the Ratio
steps.explanation: A nonzero quantity divided by itself equals $1$, so $	an(\pi/4)=1$.
steps.why: The identical numerator and denominator cancel exactly.
